title: PM Skills mission
description: Typed pipelines (pipelines/<id>.json) chained into one long, resumable run with human checkpoints. Validated by scripts/check-missions.mjs and run by the mission CLI command.

model_role.description: A role in data/models.json. Long missions suit the frontier role; default is the default role.

inputs.description: JSON Schema (object) of what the person running the mission supplies; stages refer to it as $.input.<field>

id.description: Later stages refer to a step of this stage as $.<stage>.<step>.<field>

inputs.description: Pipeline input name to a binding: a $. reference, a from/pick/map object, or a literal

checkpoint.description: What a person should review before the next stage. The run stops here until resumed.
